name: crashing-agents-jetbrains
description: Play Crashing Agents inside PyCharm and JetBrains IDEs with a native Tool Window and full-width Editor Tab.

scripts.build:plugin: node scripts/build-webview.mjs && if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -d "/Applications/PyCharm.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ]; then JAVA_HOME="/Applications/PyCharm.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew buildPlugin; else ./gradlew buildPlugin; fi
